questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: The most boring hobbies people have in Britain
How smartphones can make us more creative
Why being bored can actually be good for us
How to plan a more exciting week at work
questions.why: Neil says 'there is some good news – boredom can be good for you', and experts explain why.

Busy and very stressful
Exciting, with lots of travel
Tiring, because she worked late
questions.why: Sam says it was quiet – she hasn't done much or been anywhere, so it's been a bit boring.

questions.q: What point does Sam make about boring hobbies?
options: Everyone finds the same things boring
Hobbies are never boring if you do them often
Only older people enjoy collecting things
What bores one person may fascinate another
questions.why: She says boredom depends on your state of mind – some find something boring, others find it fascinating.

questions.q: According to Dr Sandi Mann, what is the upside of boredom?
options: It helps us sleep better at night
Our minds wander, so we get creative
It makes us work harder at our jobs
It helps us to make lots of new friends
questions.why: She says being bored lets our mind wander and daydream, which leads to problem solving and creativity.

questions.q: What is Sandi Mann afraid we are doing today?
options: Spending too much time daydreaming
Working too hard and never resting
Losing creativity by scrolling on phones
Choosing hobbies that are far too boring
questions.why: She fears that 'by swiping and scrolling our boredom away… we're losing that creativity'.

questions.q: Why does Sandi Mann think we seem more bored than ever?
options: Because modern jobs are very repetitive
Because we have less free time than before
Because there is nothing good on television
We've become addicted to new, exciting things
questions.why: She says the more we have to entertain us, the more bored we are, because we get addicted to stimulation and novelty.

questions.q: According to Manoush Zomorodi, why does boredom feel so bad at first?
options: We may think about unpleasant things
We feel guilty that we are not working
Other people think that we are lazy
We quickly become very tired and sleepy
questions.why: She says there is an uncomfortable period where you think about things you don't want to think about.

questions.q: What does Manoush suggest we should do when we feel bored?
options: Find something to watch on our phones
Stay with the feeling until good ideas come
Go to sleep until the feeling passes
Call a friend and talk about our problems
questions.why: She says 'when we stick with it that's when the good stuff can come'.
